remarks: Set on a quiet cul-de-sac in the coveted Encino Hills, this inviting single-story residence pairs relaxed California living with exceptional indoor-outdoor flow and a peaceful, private setting. South of Ventura Boulevard and moments from Mulholland Drive, the home feels wonderfully removed from the city while keeping Encino's shopping, dining and everyday conveniences within easy reach. Inside, natural light fills a spacious and flexible floor plan designed for both everyday living and entertaining.
